findings.finding: Publisher identifies original eight-violin work, 2004, duration eight minutes, premiere 1 April 2004 at USC by students of Robert Lipsett, its dedicatees. Digital score and parts are purchasable. Composer programme note characterizes sustained motoric virtuosity and speed.

Schott ED 31087 is explicitly for eight virtuoso violinists; score-and-parts edition, 102 pages. Print stock currently unavailable, while the distributor offers digital materials. Publisher lists multiple actual performances.

grade.basis: Independent repertoire-expertise judgment, supported by the composer/publisher description of motoric virtuosity throughout an eight-minute work. Fast, forceful violin writing requires reliable advanced bow control and stamina; coordinating eight individually exposed players at this sustained speed places the whole work at professional level. Balanced denotes shared virtuoso responsibility rather than a verified identical difficulty in all eight parts. No score notation was inspected in this review, and no specific unseen techniques, range limits or meters are asserted. The programme-note description and standard professional performance context support level 8; there is insufficient evidence here for an extreme-virtuoso rating.
